title: External Test Error Code Spike — {{ .name_suffix }}
description: Fires when a specific error code suddenly spikes above its learned baseline.

input.value: timeseries failures = sum(external.test.executions), filter:{test.run.status == "failed"}, interval:1m, by:{test.id, test.run.error_code, test.run.location, dt.smartscape.ext_test, dt.entity.application}

properties.value: External test error code spike: {dims:test.run.error_code} on {dims:test.id}
